small.usage: 用户明确要求的高密度表格

large.usage: 用户明确要求的疏松或复杂内容表格

size.rule: Header, body cells, fixed columns and all data rows use the same Table size variant.

columns.flexRequirement: Keep at least one primary content column flexible.
columns.overflow: Preserve readable column widths and scroll horizontally instead of compressing every column.

sort.multiColumn: Only when explicitly required; show priority.

dataStates.loading: Keep header and column geometry; use Skeleton or row-level loading.
dataStates.empty: Span all columns inside the Table container; do not create fake data rows.
dataStates.error: Keep query context and provide retry.
dataStates.paginationWithoutRows: Hide or disable; never show a fabricated total.

accessibility.header: Declare column scope and expose sorting state.
accessibility.controls: Checkboxes and icon-only actions require accessible names.

resolvedIssues.result: Table/content, Table/Collapse and Table/subcontent use Table/divider; Border/default is no longer present.
4.subTable and sub_table_item use Text/Secondary; the legacy 文本色/副文 variable is no longer present.

sourceAudit.geometryBindingPolicy: Literal geometry is permitted; do not claim Dimension Token bindings that Figma does not expose.

boundaries: Do not redraw Table structure or interaction icons in page CSS.
Use Table/border for the outer border and Table/divider for structural separators; do not substitute generic Border tokens.
Do not substitute approximate icons for Table sort, filter or expand affordances.
The Table specification page and business-pattern pages must use the same shared Table classes; documentation-only parameter tables may use ds-table.
Use small or large only when the user or an explicit design instance requires a different density.
